name: equal-weight-10m-threshold-015-full-ta-weight
rationale: Internal pattern, signal-amplitude dose test for 2026-11-01 lead #2 (does the equal-weight signal have timing value?). In every backtest the news cache is empty, so sentiment_normalized is the constant 0.5 and combined = 0.15 + 0.7 * ta: ta_weight 0.7 compresses the composite's swing by 30% toward 0.5 for no information gain. Setting ta_weight 1.0 / sentiment_weight 0.0 on the equal-weight + 600s + threshold 0.15 family restores the full swing. If the signal has timing value, a larger dose should raise gross return (and should be checked against fees); if it only increases turnover and loses, the signal has no timing value at this horizon. 'full-ta-weight-no-sentiment' was rejected on the old reversion-dominated weighting at 60s spacing, never on this family. Caveat: live, the sentiment term is not constant, so a promoted result also removes news from the live composite; that must be flagged for review.
code_change_summary: Same code change as experiment/equal-weight-rebalance-10m-threshold-015 (bc00fab): in TradingEngine::compute_btc_target (src/trading/engine.rs) set TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 0.25 to 1.0 (REVERSION_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT stays 1.0). Nothing else in the function changes; the ta_weight/sentiment_weight change is config-only. Update both constants' doc comments, add a NOTE naming this hypothesis, and update compute_btc_target_* unit tests' expected values where the change legitimately alters them (rewrite, never delete). Run the same code with the reference config (ta_weight 0.7 / sentiment_weight 0.3, threshold 0.15, 600s) on the same window at all three capitals as an unregistered reference.
constraints: This hypothesis modifies the body of TradingEngine::compute_btc_target. This change MUST be made only on this hypothesis's own dedicated isolation: "worktree" branch -- never as a direct commit to dev/main.
MUST NOT change TradingEngine::compute_btc_target's signature (its parameter list or return type) -- only its body.
MUST NOT change any individual sub-signal's own formula or the aggregation expression; exactly one numeric constant changes (TREND 0.25 -> 1.0).

MUST pass `cargo test`, including the compute_btc_target_* unit tests in src/trading/engine.rs -- update their expected values if the new weight legitimately changes them (do not weaken or delete a test just to make it pass).

A promoted change still becomes its own PR against dev (per the pipeline's step 6) and is never merged automatically -- a human reviews it like any other algorithm hypothesis. Flag explicitly in the PR description that this diff touches compute_btc_target's body, so the reviewer gives it the scrutiny an allocation-formula change deserves.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or anything on the live order-submission path.
